name: What is the difference between honed and polished countertop finishes?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between honed and polished countertop finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Honed and polished refer to the surface finish of natural stone countertops. A polished finish is shiny and reflective, bringing out the vibrant colors and patterns of the stone. It's often perceived as more formal and is less porous than honed. A honed finish is matte or satin, offering a softer, more subdued look. It's less reflective and can be more susceptible to showing fingerprints or oils, but it can also hide scratches better.
acceptedAnswer.description: Polished finishes are shiny and reflective, while honed finishes are matte or satin, each offering distinct aesthetic and maintenance characteristics.
